Job Title: Quality Assurance Analyst Job Description The Quality Assurance Analyst ensures that products consistently meet the highest standards of quality, safety, and regulatory compliance within a GMP and FDA-regulated food manufacturing environment. Working primarily on the night shift, this role performs audits, inspections, testing, and documentation to maintain compliance with GMP, SQF, HACCP, FDA, and state regulations. The analyst supports continuous improvement by collaborating with operations, sanitation, and maintenance teams to uphold robust food safety programs and a strong quality culture. Responsibilities Perform routine and non-routine quality assurance and quality control activities on 3rd shift to ensure products meet internal specifications and regulatory requirements. Conduct inspections and case audits to verify adherence to GMP, SQF, HACCP, FDA, and state regulations, as well as internal quality policies and procedures. Review and verify Certificates of Analysis (COAs) for raw materials and finished products to ensure they meet established quality standards. Perform microbiological testing and related laboratory analyses to monitor product and environmental safety. Support and maintain food safety programs by monitoring critical control points and verifying compliance with HACCP plans. Conduct mock recalls and self-inspections to assess traceability, documentation accuracy, and overall readiness for regulatory or customer audits. Review batch records and associated documentation for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with GMP and FDA requirements. Participate in environmental monitoring activities to assess and document the hygienic conditions of the facility. Identify, investigate, and document nonconformances, and support root cause analysis to determine underlying issues and prevent recurrence. Collaborate closely with operations, sanitation, and maintenance teams to resolve quality issues and drive continuous improvement in processes and procedures. Maintain accurate and timely quality documentation, including inspection records, test results, and audit findings. Support preparation for and participation in internal and external audits by providing documentation, explanations, and follow-up actions as needed. Contribute to a culture of excellence by promoting food safety awareness, regulatory compliance, and best practices across the facility.
